final_wiki.answer-Q-4875-L4X:
The greatest common divisor (GCD) of 143 and 253 is **1**. This is because 143 = 11 × 13 and 253 = 11 × 23, so their only common factor is 1 (they are coprime except for the factor 11, but 143 and 253 share no other common prime factors).

Calculation:
Using the Euclidean algorithm:
253 ÷ 143 = 1 with remainder 110
143 ÷ 110 = 1 with remainder 33
110 ÷ 33 = 3 with remainder 13
33 ÷ 13 = 2 with remainder 7
13 ÷ 7 = 1 with remainder 6
7 ÷ 6 = 1 with remainder 1
6 ÷ 1 = 6 with remainder 0
Thus, GCD = 1.
